topic: A habit tracker app for shift workers — log a habit in two taps, works offline (fictional business — example)

facts.name: Tallyday
facts.claim: Log a habit in two taps, even on a night shift with no signal
facts.howItWorks: Pick habits, tap to log, see your streak sync when you are back online
facts.homeItems: Log a habit | Tap once to mark it done ; Weekly view | See which days you kept the habit ; Reminders | Pick a time that suits your shift
facts.detailBody: Tap a habit to see its history and notes ; Entries you add offline stay on your device until you are back online
facts.resultBody: Your habit is logged ; It will sync when you are back online
facts.price: Free; Plus $3 per month, VAT included
facts.audience: Shift workers who want to build habits around irregular schedules
facts.action: Log your first habit in two taps
